thread:
kevin: saw autofallback fire in staging; console just said 'policy matched' with no metric snapshot. customer puzzled

nora: that's bad. sampling + telemetry short-circuit likely removed the window stats

kevin: proposal: always persist a tiny decision_summary (<1KB) with reason_code, rounded_value(s), threshold, mode, reroute_target, policy_ver, telemetry_coverage_est

sam: agree. UI should show the summary inline and a 'view full trace' CTA if full trace exists (gated by org debug flag)

nora: customer-facing logs should only include compact codes like FALLBACK:ER or FALLBACK:LAT and optional serving hint; no raw metrics

ops-bot: feature:decision_summary toggled ON for staging at 6823456820

kevin: i'll draft proto with coverage_reason enum and migration notes for v1->v2. flagging @sam for UX copy

sam: thumbs-up. add a migration safety gate for orgs >100k qps so we don't force heavy traces
